phase_1.title: Phase 1 · PP-19 Bizon Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 9×18mm Makarov / 9×19mm primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 160 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 160 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 195 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 340 m/s (355 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Blowback Cycle & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, closed-bolt firing relies on breechblock inertia and recoil spring tension to cycle reliably.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 64-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the PP-19 Bizon staged for its 680 RPM (Semi / Full-Auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 野牛 PP-19 Bizon 螺旋弹筒冲锋枪：1996 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: PP-19“野牛”由维克多·卡拉什尼科夫与阿列克谢·德拉贡诺夫联手研制，与 AK-74M 通用 60% 机匣与折叠托零件；独具特色的 64 发铝制螺旋供弹筒直接悬置枪管下方兼作护木，实现低矮卧姿廓形与持久火力。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：PP-19 Bizon 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1996 年问世的 野牛 PP-19 Bizon 螺旋弹筒冲锋枪 由俄罗斯伊热夫斯克机械厂（Izhmash / Kalashnikov）主导研制，定位为经典的螺旋弹筒冲锋枪。野牛冲锋枪由两位传奇枪械大师之子共同执笔研发，1996 年正式列装俄联邦安全局（FSB）及内务部特勤单位，后续亦衍生出盒式弹匣的勇士 PP-19-01。
PP-19“野牛”由维克多·卡拉什尼科夫与阿列克谢·德拉贡诺夫联手研制，与 AK-74M 通用 60% 机匣与折叠托零件；独具特色的 64 发铝制螺旋供弹筒直接悬置枪管下方兼作护木，实现低矮卧姿廓形与持久火力。 整件装备总长 660 mm（折叠托 425 mm）、空重 2.1 kg，成为同期冲锋枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1996 年，俄罗斯伊热夫斯克机械厂（Izhmash / Kalashnikov）推出了划时代的野牛 PP-19 Bizon 螺旋弹筒冲锋枪。野牛冲锋枪由两位传奇枪械大师之子共同执笔研发，1996 年正式列装俄联邦安全局（FSB）及内务部特勤单位，后续亦衍生出盒式弹匣的勇士 PP-19-01。 它的核心设计聚焦于64 发阿基米德螺旋供弹筒横置于枪管下方兼作护木，彻底消除垂挂弹匣的伏姿障碍，奠定了其在冲锋枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 野牛 PP-19 Bizon 螺旋弹筒冲锋枪 的机械灵魂在于其「闭膛待击自由枪机 · 卡拉什尼科夫机匣 + 64 发前悬螺旋弹筒」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，闭膛击发后弹壳底缘克服枪机质量与复进簧阻力直线后坐完成抽抛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。与 AK-74M 通用约 60% 冲压机匣、击发机与侧折叠枪托，极大降低俄军训维护成本，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。野牛 PP-19 Bizon 螺旋弹筒冲锋枪 采用闭膛待击自由枪机 · 卡拉什尼科夫机匣 + 64 发前悬螺旋弹筒。在每个击发周期中，闭膛击发后弹壳底缘克服枪机质量与复进簧阻力直线后坐完成抽抛。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了与 AK-74M 通用约 60% 冲压机匣、击发机与侧折叠枪托，极大降低俄军训维护成本。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 9×18mm Makarov / 9×19mm 弹药规格与 195 mm 镀铬枪管 · 4 条右旋膛线（1:240 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 160 MPa，可赋予弹头 340 m/s 的出膛初速与 355 J 动能，有效作用距离达 150 米。
内膛技术特点方面，镀铬 4 条右旋膛线兼顾 9×18mm 穿甲高膛压弹（9×18 PMM）与 9×19mm 变型。同时，闭膛自由枪机配紧凑后坐行程，空枪仅 2.1 kg 且 680 RPM 连发温顺易控，令其在 680 发/分（单发 / 全自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 195 毫米身管与 9×18mm Makarov / 9×19mm 口径，野牛 PP-19 Bizon 螺旋弹筒冲锋枪 实现了每秒 340 米的初速与 150 米有效射程。镀铬 4 条右旋膛线兼顾 9×18mm 穿甲高膛压弹（9×18 PMM）与 9×19mm 变型，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 64 发容量的大容量圆鼓/螺旋弹筒壳体与 44 mm 膛轴设计，野牛 PP-19 Bizon 螺旋弹筒冲锋枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 3.3 N·s 水平。机匣左侧保留俄制燕尾导轨，可直接快速挂装 Kobra 红点或微光夜视镜。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-65）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 64 发容量的大容量圆鼓/螺旋弹筒壳体与出色的整体工效，机匣左侧保留俄制燕尾导轨，可直接快速挂装 Kobra 红点或微光夜视镜。欢迎在 BAY-65 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 野牛 PP-19 Bizon 螺旋弹筒冲锋枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the PP-19 Bizon
paragraphs: Introduced in 1996 by Izhmash (Kalashnikov Concern) in Russia, the Izhmash PP-19 Bizon emerged as a defining Helical-Magazine Submachine Gun. Engineered by the sons of Mikhail Kalashnikov and Evgeny Dragunov, the Bizon entered FSB and MVD service in 1996 before inspiring the stick-fed PP-19-01 Vityaz.

Co-designed by Victor Kalashnikov and Alexei Dragunov, the PP-19 Bizon shares 60% of its stamped receiver and controls with the AK-74M while mounting a 64-round aluminum helical magazine underneath the barrel as its forend. Measuring 660 mm (425 mm Stock Folded) at an unloaded weight of 2.1 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Submachine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1996, Izhmash (Kalashnikov Concern) of Russia introduced the Izhmash PP-19 Bizon. Engineered by the sons of Mikhail Kalashnikov and Evgeny Dragunov, the Bizon entered FSB and MVD service in 1996 before inspiring the stick-fed PP-19-01 Vityaz. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — 64-round under-barrel helical drum doubles as the forend for a snag-free low-prone silhouette — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Izhmash PP-19 Bizon sits its Closed-Bolt Straight Blowback · AK-74M Receiver with 64-Round Under-Barrel Helical Magazine. Throughout every firing cycle, closed-bolt firing relies on breechblock inertia and recoil spring tension to cycle reliably, containing 160 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, 60% parts commonality with the AK-74M streamlines armorer logistics and operator muscle memory, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Izhmash PP-19 Bizon relies on Closed-Bolt Straight Blowback · AK-74M Receiver with 64-Round Under-Barrel Helical Magazine. During each cycle, closed-bolt firing relies on breechblock inertia and recoil spring tension to cycle reliably. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: 60% parts commonality with the AK-74M streamlines armorer logistics and operator muscle memory.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 9×18mm Makarov / 9×19mm with 195 mm Chrome-Lined · 4-Groove RH Rifling (1:240 mm Twist), the Izhmash PP-19 Bizon develops 340 m/s muzzle velocity and 355 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 150 meters.

Internally, Chrome-lined 4-groove right-hand bore supports both high-pressure 9×18mm PMM and 9×19mm Bizon-2-01 variants. Combined with its 680 RPM (Semi / Full-Auto) tempo, Lightweight 2.1 kg closed-bolt blowback chassis delivers controllable 680 RPM bursts, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 9×18mm Makarov / 9×19mm through its 195 millimeter bore, the Izhmash PP-19 Bizon achieves 340 meters per second and 150 meters of effective reach. Chrome-lined 4-groove right-hand bore supports both high-pressure 9×18mm PMM and 9×19mm Bizon-2-01 variants.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 64-round high-capacity drum magazine body with a 44 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 3.3 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Standard Soviet left-side dovetail mount accepts Kobra red-dots and night-vision optics.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-65), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
